results.title: Local girls volleyball teams ready to dig in on the court
results.description: Class 3A NorthWood continued to be a volleyball buzzsaw in 2025. Despite an up and down regular season, where the Panthers finished 21-15, head coach Hilary Laidig’s squad rallied in the postseason. NorthWood won the IHSAA Class 3A Wawasee Sectional and NorthWood Regional but fell in the championship match of the Huntington North Semistate. Laidig brings back seven varsity players for 2026 ...

results.title: With O'Connor ready to pounce, can Irish metric-milers add to medal haul?
results.description: The current medal haul in Birmingham - thanks to 22 glorious minutes on Thursday night - stands at two. If the final tally is to match the four from Rome two summers ago, then the metric-milers must again step up.

results.title: Diamondbacks blank Braves as Brandon Pfaadt outshines Chris Sale
results.description: Brandon Pfaadt outdueled 10-time All-Star Chris Sale as the visiting Arizona Diamondbacks defeated the Atlanta Braves 2-0 on Friday in the opener of their three-game series.
